mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand for housing, which in turn drives economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, which in turn drives wage growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong supply chain, which in turn drives economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales and a low unemployment rate signal a robust demand for goods and services, which in turn drives economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong retail sales growth and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate and a strong increase in housing starts signal an easing monetary cycle and a robust demand for housing, which in turn drives economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of easing monetary cycle and strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate and a strong increase in payroll employment signal a tight labor market and a robust demand for labor, which in turn drives wage growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and strong payroll employment growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP and a low unemployment rate signal a robust demand for goods and services, which in turn drives economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).
